selectedAssets.alt: Four fictional adult women in short copper, silver, plum-blue, and teal RAZE looks stand in heels beside Copenhagen's Nyhavn canal as the woman at left kisses the blonde woman's cheek, with colorful historic facades behind them.

Four fictional adult women in short amber-black, pale pink, turquoise-white, and berry RAZE outfits with colorful knee-high fashion hosiery stand together at Aarhus Dokk1 while the woman at right kisses her neighbor's cheek.

Four fictional adult women in short teal-copper, gold, burgundy-white, and blue-green RAZE looks stand in Kronborg Castle's courtyard as the blonde woman kisses the woman at left on the cheek, with star hardware across their outfits.

Four fictional adult women in short white-teal, copper-blue, plum-green, and silver RAZE looks wear sculptural white, copper, plum, and cobalt knee-high boots at a guarded Møns Klint overlook while one woman kisses another's cheek.
